Architect.description: Someone on the studio's staff. A first name alone is not an identity.

Project.description: A building project the studio works on, named by its project title.

Commission.description:
Who holds which post on a project: lead designer, project architect (job runner) or checker.
Checking a project's drawings is not designing it.

Studio.description: A line between two staff members: one is the other's line manager, or deputises for them.

Submission.description: A planning application or amendment sent to the council. drawn_by drew it, checked_by checked it, signed_by signed it off.

Hours.description: Time booked against a project. logged_by did the work, approved_by approved the timesheet.

questions.q: Who is the lead designer of Quayside Library?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Project)-[:lead_designer]->(n1:Architect) WHERE n0.project_code = 'Quayside Library' RETURN n1.staff_name AS staff_name

questions.q: Which projects are designed by me?
questions.speaker: tamar
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Architect)-[:designed]->(n1:Project) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.project_code AS project_code

questions.speaker: owain
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Architect)-[:line_manager]->(n1:Architect) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.staff_name AS staff_name
MATCH (n0:Architect)-[:reports]->(n1:Architect) WHERE n0.staff_name = 'Sigrun Halldorsdottir' RETURN n1.staff_name AS staff_name

questions.q: Was the estate scheme for a listed building?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Submission) WHERE n0.scheme = 'estate scheme' RETURN n0.listed_building AS listed_building

questions.q: Is there a record that the concept sketching was billable?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Hours) WHERE n0.task = 'concept sketching' RETURN coalesce(n0.billable, false) AS billable

questions.q: Which submissions did Hery Andriana draw?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Architect)<-[:drawn_by]-(n1:Submission) WHERE n0.staff_name = 'Hery Andriana' RETURN n1.scheme AS scheme

questions.q: Who checked the loading bay amendment?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Submission)-[:checked_by]->(n1:Architect) WHERE n0.scheme = 'loading bay amendment' RETURN n1.staff_name AS staff_name

questions.q: How long did the technical detailing take?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Hours) WHERE n0.task = 'technical detailing' RETURN n0.hours AS hours

questions.q: Which submissions concern Mill Lane Housing?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Project)<-[:project]-(n1:Submission) WHERE n0.project_code = 'Mill Lane Housing' RETURN n1.scheme AS scheme
MATCH (n0:Architect)-[:deputy]->(n1:Architect) WHERE n0.staff_name = 'Tamar Kapanadze' RETURN n1.staff_name AS staff_name

questions.q: What tasks and hours have I logged?
questions.speaker: hery
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Architect)<-[:logged_by]-(n1:Hours) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.task AS task, n1.hours AS hours
MATCH (n0:Submission) WHERE n0.scheme CONTAINS 'application' RETURN n0.scheme AS scheme

questions.q: What outcome did the reading room application get?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Submission) WHERE n0.scheme = 'reading room application' RETURN n0.outcome AS outcome
